findings.where: apps/web/e2e/e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts:418-424 (the depreciation-mock.mjs LANE_DECLARATIONS comment) and apps/web/e2e/serve-built.mjs:712-714 (the dispatch-order comment above handleDepreciationSupabase)
findings.what: Both comments say the depreciation lane shares "THREE" / "three" verbs with fixed-asset-mock.mjs and name only get_fixed_asset, get_depreciation_authority and list_depreciation_runs. The actual SHARED_RPC_VERBS registration added in this same diff (e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts:1136-1141) lists FIVE shared verbs -- the same three plus list_fixed_assets and fa_register_tie. The prose undercounts by two in both places it appears, so a future reader trusting the comment rather than the object would look for the wrong set of collisions.
findings.evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- apps/web/e2e/e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts shows the LANE_DECLARATIONS comment reading '...THREE of its verbs are also answered by `fixed-asset-mock.mjs` -- `get_fixed_asset`, `get_depreciation_authority` and `list_depreciation_runs` -- and all three are declared in SHARED_RPC_VERBS below' immediately followed, later in the same diff, by five entries under SHARED_RPC_VERBS: get_fixed_asset, get_depreciation_authority, list_depreciation_runs, list_fixed_assets and fa_register_tie (all mapping to ["depreciation-mock.mjs", "fixed-asset-mock.mjs"]). The same undercount is repeated in apps/web/e2e/serve-built.mjs's new comment above the handleDepreciationSupabase dispatch line ('the two lanes share three verbs ... all declared in SHARED_RPC_VERBS'). This is a comment-only inaccuracy: the actual registration used by the ownership census is correct and complete, so no test passes incorrectly because of it.
findings.fix: Update both comments to say "FIVE" and list all five verbs (get_fixed_asset, get_depreciation_authority, list_depreciation_runs, list_fixed_assets, fa_register_tie), or drop the enumerated count and point at SHARED_RPC_VERBS as the source of truth.
